Keep all hypothesis storage access behind workspace APIs, preserve HTTP/transaction contracts, retain critical coverage budgets and ratchet removed dependencies.
Part of #628 and C2 of #1043.

* test(relations): retain coverage and remove sensitive validation diagnostics
